chapters.title: Biodiversity and Classification
chapters.slo_codes: No SLO codes printed; 'Students' Learning Outcomes' list of 9 bullets (PDF 4)
chapters.main_concept: Introduces the three-domain system (Woese) replacing Whittaker's five kingdoms, the taxonomic hierarchy, and surveys the kingdoms of Eukarya, the major animal phyla and vertebrate classes, virus classification (ICTV criteria), biodiversity assessment (levels, random sampling, quadrat/transect/aerial, mark-recapture) and species/speciation modes.

chapters.slo_codes: No SLO codes printed; Students' Learning Outcomes list of 15 bullets (PDF 51)
